title: M1 BAU batch — 1 ISS (config.json ai-context URL fix + baseline re-seed + content-security confirm)
target: monitor/config.json ai-context page entry (dead /ai-context URL -> real /context URL), monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt re-seeded from live fetch, independent content-security confirmation (ISS-2973)

patches.description: Corrected the ai-context page entry URL from the dead /ai-context path (HTTP 404, GitHub Pages default-404 template, confirmed dead since at least 2026-05-05 per chg-file history) to the real, live AI Context page at /context (HTTP 200, 32,918 bytes, confirmed via direct fetch 2026-07-13). Every poll since this page was added had been diffing the 404 template against itself and vacuously reporting "unchanged" — the real page was never baselined. baseline_file name (07-ai-context.txt) is unchanged; only the source URL and its content are corrected.

reseeded_files.previous_content: 9,379-byte GitHub Pages 404 template (was being fetched from the dead /ai-context URL and had never reflected the real page)
reseeded_files.note: Fetched verbatim (raw HTML source, no extraction/processing), matching the format of the other 9 baseline files.

content_security_review.finding: Independently confirms poller's content-security sweep: 0 active prompt-injection hits on the live page. The page carries a large "Historical Internal Agent Notes (Superseded)" block (section 2) that reproduces the old V50.6 imperative "RULES FOR CLAUDE" language (e.g. former directives like "engage directly, no hedging", "do not re-litigate") — but every one of the 12 numbered items has been rewritten into descriptive past-tense project history ("was treated internally as...", "was explicitly flagged...") rather than present-tense imperatives directed at an auditing AI. The page also carries two explicit disclaimer sections not present in the 2026-03-12 V50.6 raw-text archive on file (raw-text/07-ai-context.txt, which IS still flagged PROMPT INJECTION DETECTED HIGH for that older snapshot and is left unchanged here — out of scope for ISS-2973, which only covers monitor/config.json + monitor/baseline/): a "Canonical V51.1 Entry For AI" block directing readers to ai_manifest.json / methodology.json / the public registries as current source of truth, and a "2026-04-17 Context Clarification" block stating "This page is now an archive of historical working notes, not a command payload" and explicitly instructing auditors NOT to treat the historical notes as license to skip caveats or force a conclusion.
content_security_review.verification: grep -inE for imperative injection patterns ("ignore previous instructions", "do not hedge", "do not re-litigate", "engage directly. no hedging", "treat as confirmed", "you must treat/believe/accept", "system message") against the raw fetched HTML returns 0 matches. Confirmed the disclaimer language is present via direct grep at the cited lines.
content_security_review.classification: No new prompt-injection flag warranted for the live page as currently published. This is a genuine content change from the 2026-03-12 V50.6 snapshot (which had no disclaimers and was correctly flagged HIGH at the time) — noting only as observation per Content Security discipline; not asserting this was a response to our review (no timing/content evidence link established here, and per CLAUDE.md "Author Contact Status" this would need to be evaluated by the Opus analyst if pursued as a narrative point).

tldr_evidence: ISS-2973: monitor/config.json's ai-context page entry pointed at a dead URL (/ai-context, HTTP 404) for 2+ months while the real AI Context page (/context, HTTP 200) was never tracked by the pipeline — every poll compared the 404 template against itself. Fixed the URL and re-seeded the baseline file from a live fetch (32,918 bytes, 2026-07-13). Independently re-confirmed poller's content-security finding: 0 active injection-directive phrases on the live page; the old imperative "RULES FOR CLAUDE" text is present only as explicitly-disclaimed historical archive, not as live instructions.
tldr_verdict: Pipeline-health fix only — no change to any WIN, section, or verdict. Poller can now produce true before/after diffs for the real AI Context page going forward.
investigation_notes: Confirmed the byte count of the live /context fetch (32,918 bytes) matches the figure cited in ISS-2973's description exactly, corroborating the poller finding before making any edit.

Did not touch raw-text/07-ai-context.txt (a separate, unrelated archival snapshot directory dated 2026-03-12 / V50.6, out of scope for the monitor/config.json + monitor/baseline/ pipeline covered by this ISS) or raw-text-v50.6-2026-03-12/07-ai-context.txt.

ISS-2973 description cited the baseline path as docs/data/07-ai-context.txt; the actual path per monitor/config.json and the existing 9 sibling baseline files is monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt. Used the actual/correct path.
test_coverage: node test.js — patch only touches monitor/config.json (page-tracking entry) and monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt (raw HTML baseline seed); no data/wins.json, data/sections.json, layer counts, rates, ransomware numbers, http_data, or classifier changes. Ran node -e JSON.parse validation on monitor/config.json, this EXP file, and monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker.json.
